title: Connectors are adapters, not the source of truth.
summary: CANONICAL treats Dropbox, Google Classroom, ClickUp, Gmail, and future services as lanes around the file spine. Public mode describes the posture; owner mode handles real readiness and approval.

connectors.name: Dropbox
connectors.posture: Discovery and owner approval come before writes.

connectors.name: Google Classroom
connectors.posture: Classroom-ready drafts only in v1; no live posting from public/demo mode.

connectors.name: ClickUp
connectors.posture: Task candidates and KPI templates stay dry-run until explicit owner approval.

connectors.name: Gmail / email
connectors.posture: Communication drafts may be prepared later; sending remains out of public/demo scope.

rules: Demo mode makes no backend connector calls.
Live writes require owner mode, classification, and an approved destination.
PRISM-private material never exports to public/demo or Classroom surfaces.
